runs.title: GTA 6 still on for November 19?
runs.summary: First release-reality report: the console commitment remains current, launch signals support confidence without guaranteeing delivery, and PC timing remains unknown.

runs.title: GTA 6 still on for November 19? Store timing checked
runs.summary: The November 19 console commitment remains current. Official PlayStation Store pages now expose regional PS5 unlock timestamps, while PC remains unannounced and leak, labor, and forecast claims do not change the release answer.

runs.title: GTA 6 still on for November 19? Fresh context checked
runs.summary: The November 19 console commitment and PS5 Store timestamps held. Rockstar Store logistics became clearer, while tribunal and Miami Beach reports added context without changing the release answer; PC remains unannounced.

runs.title: GTA 6 still on for November 19? Album and PC boundary checked
runs.summary: The console commitment held. Rockstar’s official album and Take-Two’s shareholder remarks add launch-campaign context and sharpen the PC unknown, while hardware scarcity is a buy-or-wait risk rather than readiness evidence.

runs.title: GTA 6 still on for November 19? Fresh recheck and leak boundary
runs.summary: The official console commitment held. PS5 Pro Enhanced is an official label without a published performance target; PC remains unannounced, and an old-data archive report does not change the release answer.

runs.title: GTA 6 still on for November 19? Merchandise delta checked
runs.summary: The official console commitment held. Rockstar’s Goodtime State collection adds same-date launch merchandise with the game sold separately; it sharpens the campaign-versus-readiness boundary without changing PC or delay status.

runs.title: GTA 6 November 19 date checked; performer NDA claim reviewed
runs.summary: The official console commitment remains unchanged. A performer NDA report traces to one podcast and has no independent confirmation; it does not change the date or the PC unknown.

runs.title: GTA VI still listed for November 19; order timing clarified
runs.summary: The official console commitment remains November 19. A November 18 Miami HEAT promotion adds campaign context, while Rockstar Support separates November 12 preload availability from retailer-specific delivery. PC remains unannounced; the reported NDA claim remains unverified.

runs.title: GTA 6 PC cloud route corrected; November 19 remains listed
runs.summary: The official console date remains November 19. Xbox CSO Matthew Ball ruled out exclusive streaming and PC streaming, correcting a reported launch-day PC route. Native PC timing and other cloud-device support remain unknown.

runs.title: GTA 6 remains listed for November 19; recent reveals do not prove readiness
runs.summary: The current console commitment is unchanged. Rockstar’s October 8 radio and podcast preview adds content detail, while rating-board entries do not provide release-readiness evidence.

runs.title: GTA 6 PC report: Q1 2027 is not confirmed
runs.summary: The official November 19 console commitment is unchanged. GamesBeat reported a Q1 2027 PC plan citing four anonymous sources; follow-up coverage repeats that source chain. The October 15 launch trailer confirms promotion, not build completion.

runs.title: “Still changing” does not establish a GTA VI delay
runs.summary: The November 19 console commitment remains current. Coverage reports ongoing changes without identifying their scope or schedule effect; the conditional full-build threat was reportedly withdrawn, but claims remain unverified.

runs.title: November 19 remains listed; PS5 unlock times vary by region
runs.summary: The official console date remains unchanged. Current Store pages show regional PS5 timestamps; a report of a Cyberleek return notice does not verify new material or affect schedule confidence.
